entries.german: Michel von Rosenburg erklärt, daß ihm von Philipp d. J. Grafen von Hanau für verschiedene in dessen Dienst verdorbene Pferde Genüge geschehen sei.
entries.english: Michael von Rosenberg declares that he has been duly compensated by Philipp the Younger, Count of Hanau, for various horses ruined in his service.

facts.content: acknowledged that Philipp von Hanau der Jüngere had compensated him for horses ruined in his service.
